description: Exact Spring MVC write endpoint census plus service-layer authorization semantics. Endpoint rows are reviewed policy, not generated defaults.

analysisModel.endpointEvidence: Spring RequestMappingHandlerMapping plus merged @PreAuthorize value and configured URL gate.
analysisModel.serviceEvidence: Comment-stripped lexical method-body census for SecurityUtil helpers, explicit manual-deny sites, and query/credential guards.
knownLimits: Static service checks prove required guard statements remain in the registered method, not full Java control-flow reachability.
DB-driven URL semantics are fixed to ADMIN/SYSTEM by the current secure-path config and V2_11 seed; live DB drift remains an operational concern.
The policy label ADMIN_ROLE_WITH_HIERARCHY means hasRole(ADMIN); ROLE_SYSTEM currently inherits ROLE_ADMIN and is therefore effectively included.

policyDefinitions.AUTHENTICATED: Any authenticated principal; no resource-owner assertion is claimed.
policyDefinitions.STRICT_SELF: The endpoint binds the target identifier to the current principal; no arbitrary target selector or administrator bypass is exposed by that endpoint.
policyDefinitions.SELF_WITH_CREDENTIAL: Principal-bound self service plus current credential proof.
policyDefinitions.STRICT_OWNER: Resource owner/participant only; administrator bypass is forbidden by the service guard.
policyDefinitions.OWNER_OR_ADMIN: Resource owner or ADMIN/SYSTEM service guard.
policyDefinitions.OWNER_OR_ADMIN_OR_CREDENTIAL: Owner/admin, or the resource credential branch defined by the service.
policyDefinitions.REACHABILITY_WITH_PRIVACY: Owner/shared reachability; ADMIN/SYSTEM cannot bypass personal-reference privacy.
policyDefinitions.ADMIN_OR_SYSTEM: ADMIN or SYSTEM through method security, DB URL authorization, or service guard.
policyDefinitions.ADMIN_ROLE_WITH_HIERARCHY: hasRole(ADMIN); current ROLE_SYSTEM > ROLE_ADMIN hierarchy also grants SYSTEM.
policyDefinitions.SYSTEM_ACCOUNT_IMMUTABLE: Invariant deny protecting the system re-assignment account.
